summary: The reproduction landed and the result is positive: re-executing the fixed experiment from its retained inputs in a clean copy, with no change to the scenario, isolation, eight-second window or declaration, receipt 6fc5c2c2f19c47a18d9613a11dd9863f again has comparison 0 violated at witness event index 27 — the isolated node and the majority-side leader hold different entries at the same log index while both sides had acknowledged their client writes — and comparison 1 holding at evaluated event index 29, where the flag-off control's two sides agree. The post-heal agreement violation is therefore witnessed in two independent executions of the same fixed experiment, so the limitation that it rested on a single probe no longer applies, while the window dependence stays explicit: the two-second-window receipt remains a negative for entry loss and for applied-without-log divergence. The interpretation for the multi-voter question is updated to cite both agreement receipts with joint history, keeps conclusion violated and defect_claim asserted on five complete comparisons with controls (configuration loss 15/18, minority election 22/25, single-side acknowledgement 27/29, concurrent two-sided acknowledgement 27/29, post-heal log disagreement 27/29 reproduced), and retains the honest bounds — bounded windows, a derived comparison whose entry payloads are not emitted, and a former-leader-of-an-enlarged-cluster scenario over in-memory stores.
